verdict.rationale: Discord lets apps receive server events over the Gateway WebSocket (e.g., channel updated, role created) or as HTTP event notifications, and lets developers build automated apps that act on them. Defining rules that trigger actions therefore means writing and hosting your own bot or integration code; the evidence shows no native rule builder. missing for 10: a native user-configurable rule/trigger builder (no-code automation), documented rule conditions and action types, independent or hands-on corroboration.
